name: metr_point_v0_head119_tail10
rationale: The final-MLP congestion circuit has a negative scalar readout. Its strongest positive activations coincide with underestimation in calibration. Reuse a practically disconnected neuron to encode a smooth positive correction only beyond this circuit threshold: 10% of the original suppression beyond the threshold. This leaves the original detector intact and is a handwritten piecewise-linear rule, with no fitting, gradients, optimizer, or test-derived targets.
